spans.s: vaidarveyaka, cf. vedaveyaka (IA 18; CII 1), an eel.
vaidila (CII 3), a word of uncertain import.
Vaidya (EI 9, 30; BL), a physician; member of the physician community.
vaidya-bhoga (SITI), also called vaidya-bhāga, vaidya-vṛtti; land set apart for the maintenance of the physician.
Vaidya-paricāraka, cf. Tamil Vaijya-paricārakar (EI 24), medical attendants.
vaidya-vṛtti (SII 1), land enjoyed by the Vaidyas for their maintenance; cf. vaidya-bhāga, vaidya-bhoga.
Vaidāntika (BL), an exponent of the Vedānta.
